route_steps.visible_checkpoint: First check actual Magic . Train to at least 33 for Telekinetic Grab, then to actual 54 before the Lvl-4 Enchant room: a Wizard's mind bomb supplies the remaining +3 to cast the level-57 spell. Use ordinary elemental combat spells on safe, low-defence targets and buy only the runes for the live XP gap; keep the MTA law/nature/cosmic stock separate. MTA awards Magic XP too, but neither the Chapter 1.2 exit nor its rune purchases guaranteed these spell levels. If your account already has 54, skip this bridge. For the MTA runes, use Lundail's shop inside the Mage Arena bank in deep Wilderness and bring your bank to at least: 1,650 nature runes 700 law runes 500 chaos runes 400 cosmic runes 500 water runes Do not carry the full 1.35m through Wilderness. Bank your valuable kit and coins before the dangerous approach, bring only disposable travel gear, and withdraw purchase money after reaching the safe Mage Arena bank. The bank/shop is safe, but the route to it is not; Hardcore players can instead complete The Feud plus Rogue Trader's rune-shop section and buy from Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid at a higher price. Buy an air staff, earth staff and fire staff from Zaff in Varrock if missing, plus 10 Wizard's mind bombs from Falador's Rising Sun Inn. These are MTA opening totals, not a promise of leftover alchemy runes: buy small top-ups if your point route consumes more than estimated.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: The entire reason for MTA here is Bones to Peaches. The spell costs 200 Telekinetic, 300 Alchemist, 2,000 Enchantment and 200 Graveyard pizazz points . Finish the unlock in this visit so MTA does not remain an open chore for the next ten hours. Use these buffered point targets and room loops: Graveyard — 211 points: take bones from a pile, cast Bones to Bananas , deposit the bananas in the chute, and eat bananas when you need healing. Repeat until the point target is reached. Telekinetic — 211 points: position yourself on the side of the maze that pulls the guardian toward the next opening, then cast Telekinetic Grab . Complete each maze rather than abandoning it halfway through. Alchemist — 311 points: the cabinet values rotate. Alch the item currently worth 30 coins ; ignore poor-value items. Low Alchemy works. If a Wizard's Mind Bomb gives you High Alchemy, use it for faster casts. Enchantment — 2,165 points: use the highest enchantment spell you can cast reliably. With the route's level range, Lvl-4 Enchant with a Wizard's Mind Bomb is the intended option. Prioritize the current bonus shape/corner, enchant shapes, then drop them after they score. At the rewards shop, buy 1 mud rune and 10 mist runes , then buy Bones to Peaches . The unlock requires 60 Magic, boostable : check your actual level after the room XP, train only any remainder to actual 57 , then use a Wizard's mind bomb for +3 if needed. When the spell is unlocked, MTA is finished for Chapter 1. Record your remaining nature runes: MTA consumes much of the opening stock, and 2.1 will audit and replenish to 1,590 for High Alchemy rather than counting these same runes twice.

preparation.title: The twelve foundation quests: supplies and recovery
preparation.text: Rebank between quests. The quantities below are per quest; a bar, loaf or vial handed in earlier is already spent. Use the material suppliers below for missing basics, and bring food plus a bank teleport for fights. Demon Slayer: 1 coin, a bucket of water and 25 unnoted ordinary bones . Kill chickens/cows and bank the bones until you have 25; ashes and big bones do not substitute. The three keys and Silverlight come from the quest. Keep Silverlight for Shadow of the Storm. A Porcine of Interest: 1 rope, a knife or suitable slash weapon, combat gear and food. Buy rope from Ned in Draynor; a knife avoids relying on whether your weapon can cut the vines. Vampyre Slayer: hammer and 2 coins for Morgan's requested beer at Varrock's Blue Moon Inn. Dr Harlow supplies the stake after the dialogue; carry it and the hammer during the fight. Below Ice Mountain: 1 cooked meat, 1 bread, knife and 3 coins. Buy raw beef and flour from Wydin in Port Sarim, cook the beef and make bread; do not substitute chicken or fish for cooked meat. The quest provides its other sandwich ingredients. The Golem: 4 soft clay, 1 empty vial, pestle and mortar and 1 papyrus. Buy papyrus from Aemad in East Ardougne; mine four clay south-west of Varrock and soften with water. Collect the phoenix feather and black mushrooms during the quest. Shadow of the Storm: Silverlight, 1 separate silver bar, 3 accepted dark clothing items, combat runes and food. Buy priest gown top and bottom from Thessalia in Varrock and a black wizard hat from Betty in Port Sarim; ordinary dark-looking gear is not automatically accepted. Pick a black mushroom in Uzer and use it directly on Silverlight to darken the blade. Use the quest mould and silver bar at a furnace for the demonic sigil; Silverlight must deal the finishing blow. The Lost Tribe: pickaxe, lit candle and tinderbox. Buy a candle from Catherby's candle shop if missing. Use the castle-cellar route and stay on the quest's marked cave path; a candle is not safe for exploring swamp gas elsewhere. Keep the quest's brooch and notes until its dialogue has consumed them. Enter the Abyss: no outside quest ingredient is consumed. The Mage of Zamorak supplies the scrying orb; carry it to the three required essence-mine teleports. Bank valuables before meeting him in low Wilderness, then continue his Varrock-chaos-temple dialogue. Merlin's Crystal: 1 fresh bread, tinderbox, empty bucket and combat gear. Take insect repellent from the Catherby house north of the bank, then use the bucket on the beehives for wax. Kill a bat near Keep Le Faye for bat bones; the quest supplies Excalibur. Keep that sword for Holy Grail. The Dig Site: 2 ropes, 1 empty vial, pestle and mortar, tinderbox and 1 cup of tea from the Varrock tea stall. A cut or uncut opal can be obtained by panning at the Digsite, and charcoal by searching its specimen trays. Collect the exam/panning tools there; no Shilo Village gem access is needed. Elemental Workshop I: knife, pickaxe, hammer, needle, thread, soft leather and 4 coal . Tan one cowhide into soft leather at Ellis in Al Kharid; buy needle/thread at Dommik nearby. Mine coal at 30 Mining, or buy it from Ordan after the first boat trip into Keldagrim (that trip starts The Giant Dwarf; finish it at Step 13). Keep the battered key and elemental shield. Elemental Workshop II: the same pickaxe/hammer/key and 8 new coal . Check actual 30 Smithing before starting; the earlier four coal are spent. If the key is lost, search the bookcase in the house south of the Seers' Village workshop, then use a knife on the battered book. Make and retain the mind helmet/shield as the quest directs.

preparation.title: Reusable suppliers for this chapter's missing materials
preparation.text: Check the bank first, then buy or make only the shortfall. Use the liquid-cash refill from Chapter 1.2 if purchases exceed the remaining coins; projected alchemy value is not spendable cash. Quantities in a quest's note are its own allocation, after previous uses. Tools and containers: general stores such as Lumbridge's sell hammer, chisel, tinderbox, buckets and pots. Take a knife from the Lumbridge Castle kitchen/cellar spawn or buy one from Ardougne's spice seller. Dommik in Al Kharid sells needle, thread, jewellery/sickle/holy moulds; the Varrock Sawmill sells saws and nails. Ned in Draynor sells rope; buy balls of wool from Aemad's Adventuring Supplies in East Ardougne, or shear sheep north of Lumbridge and spin their wool at the castle's first-floor spinning wheel (1 Crafting). Sarah's farm shop south of Falador sells farming tools, plant pots, compost and cure. Buy an empty item when the quest asks for empty; fill water containers at a sink or fountain. Bars and wire: use a furnace to smelt one copper + one tin into bronze (1 Smithing), iron ore into iron (15, with failed smelts possible), or one iron + two coal into steel (30). Smith one bronze bar into one bronze wire at 4 Smithing. Mine the basic ore south-east/south-west of Varrock; coal requires 30 Mining, or buy it from Ordan after the boat into Keldagrim. Gold needs 40 Smithing. The first Keldagrim boat trip starts The Giant Dwarf automatically; shopping there does not complete the quest. Planks / leather / clay / glass: cut the required tree and pay the Varrock Sawmill to convert its logs into the named plank tier. Kill a cow and pay Ellis in Al Kharid for soft or hard leather as specified. Mine clay south-west of Varrock and add water for soft clay. Charter traders sell buckets of sand and soda ash; smelt one of each at a furnace for one molten glass. Take a glassblowing pipe from the house west of Entrana's furnace (bank weapons/armour before the boat) and use it on the glass for the required item. Extra quest glass uses a fresh recipe, not the protected 1,600-piece orb allocation. Food ingredients: Wydin in Port Sarim sells flour, redberries and raw beef/chicken. Water + flour makes bread dough; bake it on a range. For a redberry pie, make pastry dough, put it in a pie dish, add redberries and bake at 10 Cooking; a pie dish spawns in Varrock Palace's kitchen. Milk a dairy cow with an empty bucket and collect eggs at Lumbridge farms. Repeat if food burns. Ordinary cooked fish for travel can come from the Fishing bank or a short Catherby catch-and-cook refill. Low-level herbs: preserve actual banked herbs first. If a named marrentill, tarromin, harralander or ranarr is missing, take combat gear, food and a bank teleport to the chaos druids near the entrance of Taverley Dungeon. Bank the matching herb drops until the requested quantity is met; no fixed kill count or Wintertodt yield is assumed. Sanfew in Taverley sells water-filled vials and pestle and mortar. Clean the herb at its Herblore level, or pay Zahur in Nardah 200 coins per herb if the requested clean herb is above your level. A herb added to water is an unfinished potion, not a finished combat potion. Enclosed light when a cave needs it: at 26 Smithing, smith one extra iron bar into an oil-lantern frame. Blow one freshly sourced molten glass into an oil lamp at 12 Crafting, then combine frame and lamp at 26 Crafting. Pick up one swamp tar in Lumbridge Swamp, use it on the Chemist's lamp-oil still west of Rimmington, fill the lantern and light it with a tinderbox at 26 Firemaking. This gives an oil lantern , not an exposed oil lamp; carry the tinderbox in case it goes out. If below a crafting/smithing gate, bridge only that live gap with ordinary glass/bars before a quest requires the enclosed light. Candles are adequate only where the quest note specifically uses them. Quest-supplied keys, moulds, letters and special plants stay with the quest until its steps consume them. Ordinary ingredient deficits are solved here; a missing special quest item is recovered from its named NPC/container in Quest Helper rather than bought from an unrelated shop.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Complete these as standalone quests, in this order: Demon Slayer A Porcine of Interest — the 1,000 Slayer XP combines with the Varrock Museum Natural History Quiz to comfortably clear Desert Treasure's 10 Slayer requirement. Vampyre Slayer Below Ice Mountain The Golem Shadow of the Storm — put the selectable 10,000 combat XP into Ranged The Lost Tribe Enter the Abyss miniquest — finish it completely so Abyss access is unlocked Merlin's Crystal The Dig Site Elemental Workshop I Elemental Workshop II — if you are still below 30 Smithing, use Giant Foundry or ordinary bars to reach 30 first Before Shadow of the Storm: check that one of the quest-reserved silver bars from 1.1 remains for its crafted demonic sigil. If it was spent, buy one replacement from the East Ardougne Silver Merchant before this quest; do not count optional jewellery as a replacement. This block restores several quests that the high-efficiency route touches in fragments. Here they are simply finished. The Dig Site is especially important because it feeds both Fossil Island and Desert Treasure; Enter the Abyss is kept because it is a permanent Runecraft/travel unlock rather than diary-only routing. By this point you are comfortably over 32 Quest Points . Go upstairs in the Champions' Guild and buy from Scavvo : 1 rune sword — specifically the rune sword , not the rune longsword 1 green d'hide chaps 1 green d'hide vambraces Keep all three. The rune sword is the simple melee weapon used through the rest of Chapter 1 and early Chapter 2, and the green d'hide is useful early Ranged/quest gear. Before leaving the bank: check the quest-specific quantities and sources in the preparation note.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: This is a resource step first and a Mining-XP step second. Withdraw a pickaxe, desert clothing, waterskins/food, about 80,000 gp , and the 1,600 noted empty buckets banked in 1.2. Go to the Desert Quarry / Sandstorm grinder and give the noted buckets to Drew . Mine sandstone and deposit every piece into Sandstorm . Continue until the grinder is holding enough processed sand for 1,600 buckets . Sand yield depends on sandstone size, so the target is the grinder total—not 1,600 individual rocks. Pay Drew 50 gp per bucket and withdraw exactly 1,600 buckets of sand . That costs 80,000 gp . Mining-level choice: staying at sandstone until roughly 43 Mining matches the source route and gets most of the level quickly. If the 1,600-sand resource target is already finished and you are tired of the desert, leave immediately and finish the level at Shooting Stars instead. After the sand is banked, use tier 4 or lower Shooting Stars with your best available pickaxe for the relaxed route; use a rune pickaxe if you already have one. Continue until you have both 44 Mining and 2,000 total stardust . If 44 Mining comes first, keep mining stars until 2,000 stardust. Do not spend the stardust: early Chapter 2 buys the Celestial ring with all 2,000.

preparation.title: Moulds, wool and enchantment runes
preparation.text: Buy ring, necklace, amulet and bracelet moulds from Dommik in Al Kharid . Use cut gems and gold bars at a furnace; amulets additionally need one ball of wool each before enchanting. Aemad's Adventuring Supplies in East Ardougne sells balls of wool, or shear sheep north of Lumbridge and spin their wool at Lumbridge Castle's first-floor wheel (1 Crafting). Necklaces and rings do not require wool. Enchant only the pieces being made: Lvl-1 Enchant uses 1 cosmic + 1 water per sapphire item, Lvl-2 uses 1 cosmic + 3 air per emerald item, and Lvl-3 uses 1 cosmic + 5 fire per ruby item. Equip the matching elemental staff to cover those elemental runes. Buy cosmic shortfalls from Ali Morrisane's unlocked rune shop or Lundail using the travel precautions in Step 1; the MTA balance is not an untouched enchanting reserve. Bracelets of clay use sapphire bracelets and Lvl-1 Enchant; the binding necklace uses an emerald necklace. The eight bracelet sapphires are already included in the 20-sapphire total.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Unlock digsite pendants before enchanting ruby necklaces. After The Dig Site, clean uncleaned finds in the Varrock Museum until you uncover a clean necklace (random; keep cleaning until it appears). Show it to an archaeologist in the cleaning area to learn the special Lvl-3 Enchant recipe. Then make/enchant the ruby necklaces at 49 Magic , already cleared by the MTA preflight. Ordinary ruby-necklace enchantment does not automatically work before this unlock; count any Kudos earned here toward Step 6. Once your Crafting level allows it, make at least the following working stack: 20 rings of dueling 10 digsite pendants 10 games necklaces 5 necklaces of passage if jade and silver are already banked ; otherwise defer this convenience stock The full Chapter 1 target is 40 rings of dueling, 45 digsite pendants and 10 games necklaces , plus 8 bracelets of clay, 2 sapphire amulets, 1 ruby amulet and 1 binding necklace . From an empty jewelry bank this is 107 gold bars, 41 emeralds, 46 rubies and 20 sapphires ; the five separate jade passage necklaces take five additional silver bars if chosen. Never spend the remaining quest-reserved silver bars on those optional necklaces. Count finished pieces and gems before sourcing anything. Wintertodt/Tempoross rewards are variable, not a guarantee. For missing precious gems before Shilo Village, keep the 2,000 stardust reserved for the Celestial ring untouched and mine extra Shooting Stars for the low-attention route: each additional 300 stardust buys a 40-gem bag from Dusuri at the Mining Guild entrance. Contents vary, so open bags and stop at the live shortfall; do not project a fixed bag count. preparation.title: Priest in Peril, Bone Voyage and the first camp bank
preparation.text: Priest in Peril: empty bucket, combat supplies and 50 unnoted rune or pure essence . Mine any deficit using Aubury's Varrock essence teleport after Rune Mysteries; deliver it in multiple trips. Keep the bucket for the blessed-water sequence. Bone Voyage: 2 vodka + 1 marrentill potion (unf) . Buy vodka from Heckel Funch in the Grand Tree. Put one clean marrentill in a vial of water at 5 Herblore; do not add unicorn horn dust. If no herb remains, use the herb recovery below. The Apothecary makes the potion of sealegs from these ingredients after the quest dialogue. Fossil Island camp: prioritise the bank chest with 2 oak planks, 1 iron bar, 5 nails, hammer and saw at 21 Construction. Buy saw/nails and convert two cut oak logs at the Varrock Sawmill if missing. If below 21, do the Construction catch-up immediately below first. Other camp facilities are optional conveniences; they are not a condition for birdhouse runs. Wear leather gloves and leather boots and collect the trowel, rock pick and specimen brush from the museum's tool rack for cleaning finds. Buy replacement gloves/boots from a general or clothing shop rather than assuming combat vambraces work. Bring a pickaxe for the volcanic-ash stop; the 1,000-ash target is separate from the quest inventory.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Complete Priest in Peril first. Then go to the Varrock Museum and make the 100-Kudos requirement explicit rather than assuming it happened in the background: Complete the Natural History Quiz in the museum basement if you have not already. Take the Hunter and Slayer XP. Talk to Historian Minas and tell him about every completed quest he will accept for Kudos. Check your total. If you are below 100 Kudos , use the museum cleaning area and complete unidentified-cleaned-find displays until the total reaches at least 100. Once the museum shows 100+ Kudos , complete Bone Voyage . On Fossil Island, build the camp facilities you can build and unlock the Mushroom Meadow, Verdant Valley and House on the Hill mushtrees . Use a digsite pendant on the strange machine in the House on the Hill so future pendants can teleport there directly. While you are already on the island, mine and bank at least 1,000 volcanic ash ; this becomes ultracompost later. Before leaving the bank: check the quest-specific quantities and sources in the preparation note.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Make the first four clockworks: at actual 25+ Construction , add a POH workshop if needed, build crafting table 1 with four oak planks , then upgrade it to crafting table 2 with one molten glass from the specifically reserved crafting-table glass. A new workshop costs 10,000 coins ; buy the four oak planks by converting oak logs at the sawmill if needed. Use four steel bars on the table (one per clockwork). Check for banked bars first; smelt any shortfall from iron ore and coal. The clockworks return when you harvest completed bird houses, so these are not four new bars every run. Bring each run: a hammer, chisel, 4 clockworks , 4 logs for the highest birdhouse tier you can currently make , 40 cheap bait seeds , and a digsite pendant. Low-level hop seeds such as barley or hammerstone from Olivia's Draynor Seed Market remain an easy default; eligible flower and allotment seeds also work. Keep seeds reserved for named crops and quests out of the birdhouses. Ten low-level seeds fill each house, so buy or use only enough for the houses you actually plan to set rather than assuming a fixed daily run. Use each clockwork on a log to make 4 bird houses . Teleport to the House on the Hill . Mushtree to Verdant Valley and place the two bird houses there. Mushtree to Mushroom Meadow , place the bird house there, then run south to the Tar Swamp entrance and place the fourth. Use 10 cheap seeds on each bird house . After roughly 50 minutes , harvest all four. You get the clockworks back; bring four replacement logs and another 40 seeds next run. Scheduling rule: do birdhouses when you log in, finish a quest, or want a two-minute break. The route wants passive Hunter XP; it does not require alarm-clock efficiency. preparation.title: RFD opening, Goblins, Mountain Dwarf and Pirate Pete
preparation.text: Opening cook: 1 eye of newt from Betty in Port Sarim, 1 Greenman's ale from Yanille's Dragon Inn, 1 rotten tomato from the crate by Varrock's pillory, ashes from a burnt log, and a fruit blast you make yourself . Buy a cocktail shaker, cocktail glass, 1 pineapple, 2 lemons and 1 orange from the Grand Tree's cocktail/grocery shops; mix a fruit blast in the shaker, pour it, and garnish with a slice cut from the second lemon using a knife. Then add the ashes for the dirty blast. A premade fruit blast does not work. Goblin generals: fresh bread, orange, knife, blue/green/purple dye, spice or gnome spice, fishing bait, bucket of water and charcoal. Buy orange/spice from the Grand Tree or unlocked Culinaromancer's Chest, bait from Gerrant, charcoal from Jiminua. For a new blue dye, pay Wyson in Falador Park 20 coins for 2 woad leaves, then give both leaves and 5 coins to Aggie in Draynor. Prepare the unusual coloured/soggy food during the subquest. Mountain Dwarf: 320 coins, bucket of milk, pot of flour, egg, bowl of water and 4 Asgarnian ales (buy the ales from Kaylee in Falador's Rising Sun Inn). The unlocked chest sells milk/flour/egg; the Lumbridge basement has a bowl and sink. Wear ordinary leather gloves to pick up the hot rock cake, then kill an Ice Mountain icefiend to cool it. Ice gloves are a convenience here, not a new mandatory detour. Keep the dwarven rock cake afterwards. Pirate Pete: empty fishbowl, needle, pestle and mortar, knife, 3 bronze wire , raw cod and fresh bread. Smith three bronze bars into three wire at 4 Smithing (each bar is one copper + one tin); these are separate from Fenkenstrain's later three wires. Buy a big fishing net from Harry in Catherby and fish there for a raw cod at 23 Fishing if none remains. Murphy supplies the diving gear during the quest; keep it. Catch the underwater ingredients there, and replace cod/bread if the fishcake burns.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: If Cook's Assistant is not complete, finish it first. Start Recipe for Disaster , finish the opening cook section, then complete these three subquests one at a time: Freeing the Goblin generals Freeing the Mountain Dwarf Freeing Pirate Pete Pirate Pete item check: bring an empty fishbowl for the diving apparatus. If none is banked, blow one from one of the two spare molten glass at your already-verified 46+ Crafting (42 Crafting is needed); this uses 42.5 Crafting XP and still leaves the other spare glass protected for Chapter 2. Do not take a glass from the 1,590 orbs or named quest reserves. Your 1.2 quest work and 60 Cooking make this a clean time to close all three rather than starting them and carrying their ingredients through half the chapter. Freeing the Mountain Dwarf awards 1,000 Slayer XP. Combined with the 1,000 XP from A Porcine of Interest and 1,000 XP from the Varrock Museum Natural History Quiz, the route now guarantees 3,000 Slayer XP (level 16) . Part 1.4 will use one short Slayer assignment to close the remaining 523 XP to level 18 before Animal Magnetism. Before leaving the bank: check the quest-specific quantities and sources in the preparation note.

preparation.title: Raw fish for the lyre and Mountain Daughter's crossing
preparation.text: The Fremennik Trials: bring 5,250 coins, tinderbox, knife, axe and 1 raw shark, raw manta ray or raw sea turtle . Check the reward-fish bank first; if empty, buy one raw shark from Rufus's Meat Emporium in Canifis after Priest in Peril, or Frankie's Fishing Emporium in Port Piscarilius. Wait for stock or try another world if bought out. Do not cook this offering and do not grind 76 Fishing for it. The quest supplies the swaying-tree branch and golden fleece for your lyre; the local onion, cabbage and potato feed Lalli's stew. Check actual 25 Fletching/40 Woodcutting if making the lyre; these are below this route's established targets. Koschei's final form need not be defeated. Mountain Daughter: 1 rope, pickaxe, axe, any plank, leather gloves and an elemental staff or the pole from the goat pen north of Hamal's tent. A dramen staff and vambraces do not satisfy the staff/gloves checks. Buy a normal plank from the sawmill by converting one ordinary log if none remains; keep food and your combat weapon for the Kendal.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Complete The Fremennik Trials from start to finish. Then complete Mountain Daughter . These quests establish the Fremennik foundation used heavily in later chapters. Before leaving the bank: check the quest-specific quantities and sources in the preparation note.

preparation.title: Sickle, serum, conductor and hangover-cure ingredients
preparation.text: Nature Spirit: ghostspeak amulet and silver sickle. Use one silver bar with a sickle mould bought from Dommik at a furnace (18 Crafting). Drezel and the quest supply the food, mirror and spell; finish with the blessed sickle and druid pouch retained. Shades of Mort'ton: 2 clean tarromin + 2 water-filled vials + 2 ashes , 1 normal log, tinderbox, hammer and about 5,000 coins for Razmire's local supplies. Read the book first, then make Serum 207 at 15 Herblore; these herbs are additional to the later Kourend diary's tarromin. Join the official Shades of Mort'ton world for temple repair, buy timber/limestone/swamp paste and olive oil in Mort'ton, sanctify the oil at the charged temple and use it on the log. The quest supplies the remains by killing a shade; you do not need a stock of higher pyre logs. Creature of Fenkenstrain: ghostspeak amulet, hammer, spade, needle, 5 thread, 3 new bronze wire, 1 new silver bar , 100 coins plus either Telekinetic Grab runes or another 50 coins for the pickled brain. Buy the brain from the Canifis pub if using coins. Smith the wires from three bronze bars; collect the body parts, garden cane and quest conductor mould during the quest. Keep the ring of charos. Plague City: dwellberries, spade, rope, bucket of milk, chocolate dust and 1 snape grass . Pick dwellberries in McGrubor's Wood, milk a Lumbridge dairy cow, crush a chocolate bar from the Grand Tree with a pestle and mortar, and pick snape grass on the hobgoblin peninsula west of the Crafting Guild. No Farming level or seed is needed. This grass is spent on the hangover cure; do not count it toward later prayer potions. Keep the gas mask.

preparation.title: Lost City kit and the three items your account actually rolls
preparation.text: Lost City: reach actual 31 Crafting/36 Woodcutting, bring a knife, combat runes and food, and bank weapons/armour before boarding for Entrana. Kill the dungeon zombies for a bronze axe, use Magic from behind the mushrooms against the tree spirit, then cut dramen branches and knife them into staffs. Make one working staff and at least one spare for recovery; you cannot take a normal axe through the monks' equipment check. Fairytale I: dramen staff, ghostspeak amulet, spade and secateurs from Sarah's farm shop south of Falador. Dig the Draynor skull from the grave north of the manor when asked. Read Malignius's actual three-item request before shopping; use the branch table below. Bring a filled druid pouch for edible items crossing Mort Myre: Bloom with the blessed sickle, collect extra swamp produce and fill the pouch without consuming a requested pear/stem/fungus. Only collect your rolled items. They are not guaranteed by Wintertodt, and a high Farming or Herblore level is not the default solution: White berries: kill chaos druid warriors in Yanille Agility Dungeon (40 Agility) for one; stay away from the chaos altar that drops you into poison spiders. Mort myre pear / stem / fungus: Bloom with the blessed sickle beside a bush / branch / rotten log respectively; collect the required produce loose. Nature talisman: if no reward/drop is banked, buy one for 50 abyssal pearls from Apprentice Felix at Guardians of the Rift after Temple of the Eye. If Temple of the Eye is unfinished, first reach 10 Runecraft (Enter the Abyss is already done; mine rune essence through Aubury and craft air runes at the altar south of Falador for the small remaining XP gap; if the air talisman is missing, kill the air wizard beside Malignius Mortifer north-west of Port Sarim until it drops one), then take a bucket of water, pickaxe and chisel to Wizard Persten north of Al Kharid and complete its tutorial. For normal rounds, enter the basement rift below the Wizards' Tower with pickaxe/chisel: mine guardian fragments, make guardian essence, craft at the active altars you can use, then deliver the resulting stones to the Great Guardian. Earn both elemental and catalytic energy, claim rewards and stop once the actual pearl balance reaches 50. This conditional unlock is only for a missing talisman; do not rely on fairy-ring Abyss access before Fairytale I. Clean avantoe / irit leaf: get the grimy herb from banked drops or Taverley chaos druids; if below 48 / 40 Herblore, pay Zahur in Nardah 200 coins to clean the requested herb. Do not turn it into an unfinished potion. Blue dragon scale: take an anti-dragon shield and pick a ground scale in Taverley Dungeon's blue-dragon chamber. If you do not have the shield yet, start Dragon Slayer I at the Champions' Guild and obtain it from Duke Horacio first. Below 70 Agility, free Velrak in the Black Knights' base for the dusty key. Bring antipoison, food and a teleport; no dragon kill is required. Proboscis / volencia moss: do Jungle Potion now if either is rolled, then collect mosquito proboscis during Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup or clean the moss from the jungle-mine rocks. This brings forward only that prerequisite; keep the later 31-Herblore check as a live level check and do not add Jungle Potion's XP twice. Jangerberries / lime: use banked Hosidius fruit-stall produce; otherwise steal jangerberries there at 25 Thieving and buy a lime from the Grand Tree. Potato cactus: take a rope, antipoison, food and a teleport to the Kalphite Lair west of Shantay Pass. Use the entrance rope and collect a ground potato cactus near the soldiers; no seed or 64 Farming is required. Crushed gem / unopened oyster: pan at the Digsite for opals/oysters. Keep an oyster unopened. Cut spare opals with a chisel until one fails into a crushed gem; a cut opal is not a substitute. Clean snapdragon: the Brimhaven Agility Arena sells one for 10 Brimhaven vouchers. At this route's 50+ Agility, tag consecutive active ticket dispensers until you have 10 Brimhaven vouchers, and buy one herb from Pirate Jackie the Fruit. This replaces an assumed high-level herb bank. Supercompost: put 15 pineapples from a charter shop in an empty compost bin, close it, then return after rotting and take one bucket of supercompost. This is separate from Garden of Tranquillity's later reward. Babydragon bones: kill a baby blue dragon in Taverley Dungeon; use the same dusty-key route as the scale. Jogre bones: kill a jogre in Pothole Dungeon on Karamja. These are specific bones, not ordinary or adult dragon bones. Uncut diamond / uncut ruby: use banked uncut gems or the extra-stardust gem bags from Step 5, preserving the 2,000 ring reserve. Stop when the requested uncut stone appears; a cut gem will not work. Raw cave eel / raw slimy eel: fishing rod and bait from Gerrant, plus a lit enclosed oil lantern, for Lumbridge Swamp Caves; 38 / 28 Fishing respectively. Enter through the Lost Tribe castle route and avoid cave hazards. Keep the fish raw. The lantern recipe is in the material-suppliers note. Edible seaweed: pick the edible-seaweed spawn on Fossil Island's north-east coast; ordinary seaweed is different. Red vine worm: dig in McGrubor's Wood with a spade. Fat snail: kill a bruise or blood blamish snail in Mort Myre and keep its raw meat. Charcoal: Jiminua's Jungle Store. Red spiders' eggs: ground spawns by the moss giants at the west end of Varrock Sewers, with a knife for webs. Grapes: the now-unlocked Culinaromancer's Chest. King worm: ground spawns north-west in the Gnome Stronghold. Snape grass: ground spawns west of the Crafting Guild. For Tanglefoot, equip the magic secateurs ; ordinary weapons cannot finish this fight. Without 43 Prayer yet, use the mushroom/corridor flinch: hit once, return behind the obstacle and wait for its health bar to disappear before the next hit. Bring food for mistakes and bank the spare dramen staff in Zanaris.

Why Fairytale I is here: it awards 3,500 Farming XP . That is enough to clear the 17 Farming requirement for Forgettable Tale even if you started with essentially no Farming XP. preparation.title: Keldagrim errands and the complete kelda brewing kit
preparation.text: The Giant Dwarf: bring at least 2,500 coins plus a purchase buffer, a log, tinderbox, 1 coal, 1 iron bar, 3 cut sapphires, 1 law + 1 air rune for Telekinetic Grab, and a fresh redberry pie for Thurgo unless you already gave him an extra. Ordan sells coal/ore, the city jeweller sells cut sapphires, and a furnace turns iron ore into an iron bar at 15 Smithing. Bake the pie from flour/water/pie dish/redberries at 10 Cooking. Company errands request variable ores and bars: accept the task, buy its ore from Ordan and smelt any requested bars at the relevant Smithing level, then return before the timer expires. Let an awkward high-tier request expire and ask again; do not spend protected quest silver or manufacture a fixed universal ore list. Forgettable Tale: 500 coins, 2 barley malt, 2 buckets of water, rake, seed dibber, 1 kebab, 3 beers, 1 dwarven stout and an empty beer glass, plus the actual Rowdy dwarf request. The Keldagrim food shop sells the kebab and its pubs sell beer; pick up the dwarven stout from the table beside Khorvak in the pub under White Wolf Mountain; drinking a spare beer supplies the glass. If the two barley malt are missing, buy four barley seeds from Olivia in Draynor, plant them in the hops patch north of Lumbridge's cow field with a rake/seed dibber, and use compost/water. At 3+ Farming, harvest the mature barley and cook two on a range to make malt; plain barley does not work. This short crop is a quest ingredient, not a general Farming grind. The quest gives all four kelda seeds; grow them in its special patch, harvest the kelda hops, then add the two waters, two barley malt, hops and yeast to the brewing vat (take the nearby empty pot and pay Blandebir 25 coins for the yeast). Keep the empty glass to draw the finished beer. Wait until the vat is ready before drawing it; starting the timer does not mean the stout is already in your bank.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Complete The Giant Dwarf . If its variable company errand asks for silver bars, buy those in addition to the remaining quest-reserved bars at the East Ardougne Silver Merchant rather than spending the Animal Magnetism/Desert Treasure stock. Then start Forgettable Tale... and begin the kelda brewing/fermentation step. The Rowdy dwarf's kelda-seed item request varies: ask what he wants, check the bank, and if that particular item is awkward tell him you do not know where to get it to request another item. Do not pre-bank a guessed universal item. Fermentation is a real timer, so this is the one place where leaving a quest waiting is intentional. Use the wait for a birdhouse run, a Crafting/Fletching session, or another finished activity. Return when the brew is ready and finish Forgettable Tale completely . Farming dependency solved: The Goblin generals subquest gave 1,000 Farming XP , Fairytale I gives 3,500 , and Forgettable Tale gives 5,000 . That is 9,500 Farming XP before the Zeah block, already enough for 26 Farming . The Garden of Death later in this subsection adds another 10,000 Farming XP , so 1.4 begins with at least 19,500 XP (level 33) . Garden of Tranquillity therefore has no hidden Farming grind. Before leaving the bank: check the quest-specific quantities and sources in the preparation note.

preparation.title: Death Plateau's food order and the Troll Stronghold fight
preparation.text: Death Plateau: 60 coins, 1 premade Blurberry special, 1 iron bar, 10 unnoted bread and 10 unnoted cooked trout . Buy the premade drink from Blurberry's Grand Tree bar; ordinary beer is not a replacement for this item. Steal bread at the Ardougne bakery stall or bake it; fly-fish and cook ten trout at Barbarian Village if the Fishing stock is gone. Smith the iron bar from mined/bought iron ore at 15 Smithing, allowing for failed smelts. These supplies are separate from later spiked boots and quest food. Troll Stronghold: wear climbing boots; buy a replacement from Tenzing for 12 coins if needed. Bring combat runes, food and a bank teleport for Dad and the guards; use the arena fence to keep Dad away while casting. Protection prayers are helpful if already unlocked, but this chapter has not yet guaranteed 43 Prayer. Buy the five spare boot pairs after Death Plateau; one later becomes Desert Treasure's spiked boots.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Complete Death Plateau , then complete Troll Stronghold . Buy and bank 5 extra pairs of climbing boots while the shop access is convenient. During Troll Stronghold, make sure you free Eadgar and unlock the southern shortcut/entrance. These quests are direct prerequisites for Eadgar's Ruse and Desert Treasure . Bring combat gear, food, vials of water and a teleport; drops vary, so stop on actual 31 , not a promised kill count. Keep one harralander back for Heroes' Quest. preparation.text: Jungle Potion supplies its own five herbs from the jungle locations after Trufitus tells you what to find. Bring food and antipoison for the spiders. For Cleanup, buy the machete there, cut light jungle and repair the village fence; handle or avoid spawned enemies, check favour with a villager, and stop at 60% . If the quest was completed early for Fairytale I's random items, do not count its XP again here.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Complete Jungle Potion if not already finished for Fairytale I. Then bring a machete, antipoison, food and basic melee-defence gear to Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup ; switch auto-retaliate off. Hack jungle and handle the resulting encounters, or kill the local jungle spiders if you prefer, until your favour reaches at least 60% . My Arm's Big Adventure spends 60 percentage points; this is the actual mandatory consumer. Stop here if you are not deliberately pursuing the diary. preparation.title: Supplies for every quest in the Zeah block
preparation.text: The Queen of Thieves: 1 stew. Buy a cooked stew from the Seers' Village pub or Warriors' Guild food shop if accessible; the Seers' pub needs no guild entry. Keep it for the quest instead of eating it. The Depths of Despair: no outside quest item; bring combat gear, food and a teleport for the Sand Snake. Its scrolls/key are quest-local. The Forsaken Tower: no outside ingredient; collect the building's tools and puzzle materials during the quest. No pre-banked potion recipe is needed. Tale of the Righteous: pickaxe, rope, a ranged weapon with matching ammunition and runes for a combat spell. Bring both ranged and Magic even if you normally melee. If no ranged weapon/ammunition remain, buy a shortbow and 20 bronze arrows from Lowe in Varrock; take air/mind runes from Aubury or Betty for Wind Strike. Refill the actual ammunition/rune shortfall if needed. The Garden of Death: secateurs, obtainable inside the quest or reused from Sarah's shop. Bring food for the surrounding creatures; the tablets and notes are collected along the route. The Ascent of Arceuus: no outside quest ingredient; take combat gear, food and a teleport for the trapped souls. Getting Ahead: actual 26 Construction, bear fur, 1 soft clay, hammer, saw, 2 normal planks, at least 6 nails (take spares), knife, red dye, flour, needle and thread. The farm supplies the construction/crafting materials when searched; kill a bear west of it for fur. Use those local supplies before buying duplicates, and take any free replacement nails if some bend. Finish and retain the Kharedst's memoirs pages as each quest awards them. If a later teleport is depleted, recharge the book at the Old Memorial using the required runes; an unlocked destination does not guarantee remaining charges.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Zeah is the one area where several quests are worth grouping because they share the same travel network. Keep the geographic cluster, but finish each quest before beginning the next. Complete these one at a time , rebanking whenever useful: The Queen of Thieves The Depths of Despair The Forsaken Tower The Tale of the Righteous The Garden of Death The Ascent of Arceuus Getting Ahead Woodcutting Guild supply stop: while this Zeah block has you moving through Hosidius, stop at Perry’s Chop-chop Shop if you have reached 60 Woodcutting . Also buy and bank a cheap mithril axe ; the Ranged block in 1.4 now completes Animal Magnetism before the long crab grind, so this prevents a return trip. If you are still below 60 Woodcutting here: do not interrupt the quest block just to force the level. Keep using the steel axe for now. During the 1.4 Woodcutting break, reach 60, enter the Woodcutting Guild, buy the rune axe (and mithril axe), then continue toward 70. The guild itself requires 60 Woodcutting; the rune axe only requires 41 Woodcutting to chop with once you own it. Unlock the Mount Quidamortem mountain-guide shortcut when The Tale of the Righteous takes you there. That is a worthwhile permanent travel unlock rather than an incidental diary click. route_steps.visible_checkpoint: If you have never done Fossil Island or Sulliusceps before, do not treat this as “just go chop mushrooms.” Sulliusceps are giant mushrooms inside the Tar Swamp on Fossil Island . Only one of six locations is active for your character at a time; after you chop the active mushroom down, the next one becomes active and you continue around the route. The first trip is the confusing one. Once the southern teleport is unlocked and you have seen the loop once, repeated clears are much simpler. Bring: your rune axe (or dragon axe if Wintertodt gave you one), a rake , antipoison , plenty of food , Fossil Island access such as a digsite pendant , and a teleport out. Keep several free inventory spaces for caps, fossils and other drops. The swamp has dangerous tar monsters and poisonous spine mushrooms; chopping is fairly low-attention, but moving between spots is not walk-away AFK. Get into the swamp: use the Fossil Island mushtree network to reach Mushroom Meadow , then head south into the Tar Swamp. Cut blocking vines/roots with your axe and rake the ground vines when the route requires it. Unlock Sticky Swamp immediately: on the first lap, activate the Sticky Swamp Magic Mushtree near the southern/bottom part of the route. From then on you can teleport straight back to the useful end of the swamp instead of repeating the ugly entrance every trip. Avoid the hazards instead of fighting them: do not intentionally fight tar monsters. Keep moving, eat when needed, and use terrain to get away. Antipoison is for the spine-mushroom poison. Follow the rotation: find the active Sulliuscep, chop it until it depletes, then move to the next active location. After your first complete lap, this becomes a repeatable circuit rather than a scavenger hunt. Bank caps if they arrive while training

preparation.title: Garden of Tranquillity's actual seeds and tools
preparation.text: Bring the ring of charos, rake, seed dibber, spade, secateurs, watering can, gardening trowel, 2 plant cures, 1 marigold seed, 3 cabbage seeds, 3 onion seeds (six of each allotment seed gives a replant buffer), a fishing rod or fly fishing rod, hammer, 1 rune/pure essence, pestle and mortar, 1 filled plant pot and 2 buckets of compost . Sarah's farm shop south of Falador sells the tools, plant pots, compost and plant cure. Olivia in Draynor sells the marigold/cabbage/onion seeds; the quest's special rose/orchid/delphinium/snowdrop seeds are obtained from the gardeners. Buy a rod from Gerrant if the Fishing rod is missing and mine one essence through Aubury's teleport. Fill the plant pot from a farming patch with the trowel. Plant and tend the actual quest crops, keeping the requested mature marigolds in place until the gardener's dialogue accepts them; earlier random seed rewards are not the supplier.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: You already have at least 33 Farming from the Chapter 1.3 quest rewards and Creature of Fenkenstrain is complete, so do Garden of Tranquillity from start to finish now. Bring the ring of charos from 1.3. Farming math: By this point the route has awarded at least 19,500 Farming XP : 1,000 from the Goblin generals subquest, 3,500 from Fairytale I, 5,000 from Forgettable Tale, and 10,000 from The Garden of Death. That is at least level 33 . Garden of Tranquillity adds another 5,000 XP , so both Enlightened Journey (30 Farming) and My Arm's Big Adventure (29 Farming) are already covered with no hidden farm run. Make the compost rather than assuming it appeared: fill an ordinary compost bin with 15 weeds or other compostable produce , close it and let it process for roughly an hour while you continue the quest. Garden of Tranquillity rewards a four-dose compost potion. Once the bin is ready, open it and use one dose on the full bin to upgrade its 15 normal compost to 15 supercompost ; collect it with 15 empty buckets. Bank those 15 before leaving this Farming block: 8 supercompost are reserved for My Arm’s Big Adventure: seven for the soil and one for the crop. The remaining 7 are a small Farming/Herblore buffer; use these as needed while keeping the eight My Arm buckets reserved. Other compost-potion doses can upgrade later normal compost; volcanic ash from Fossil Island can later turn supercompost into ultracompost. Start the Chapter 2 teak timer now: Garden of Tranquillity pushes the guaranteed quest XP past 35 Farming . If you have the 2 teak seeds reserved from birdhouses, put each seed in a filled plant pot with a gardening trowel, water it, wait for the sapling, then plant the two saplings in the two western Fossil Island hardwood patches with a spade. preparation.title: Troll truth serum, the parrot and the ranarr you must reserve

preparation.title: Give yourself the best chance to hop before a PKer lands the first hit
preparation.text: Before the first trip, set Private chat to Friends or Off. With Private set to Friends, players who are not on your Friends List see you as offline. That prevents a random PKer from simply adding your name and using private-chat status to follow your world between trips. Keep the logout/world-switch interface ready while you offer bones. A very practical setup is to open the World Switcher and leave the cursor over a different world. If another player logs in beside the altar and has not hit you yet, switch immediately instead of waiting to decide whether they look dangerous. Once you are in combat, you cannot world-hop and must be out of combat for 10 seconds first. Do not always hop to the next world in the list. Choosing a world several entries away is a reasonable anti-pattern habit because PKers often cycle through worlds looking for altar users. This is not protection or a guarantee—just a small way to make your next destination less predictable. The first hit is the important one. There is very little you can do once a geared PKer has landed a freeze/Tele Block and put you in combat. Your best defence on this low-risk route is noticing the login quickly, hopping before the first attack, and never risking more than one inventory of bones. Wine of Zamorak is for a clean suicide after the inventory is finished. When no player has damaged you, repeatedly taking the wine is a convenient way to die and return to your respawn point instead of running south. Do not rely on the wine to deny a PKer your remaining bones. If another player has already damaged you recently, the death uses Wilderness PvP death rules even if the wine deals the final point of damage; lost tradeable items are awarded under the PvP rules, generally to the player who dealt the most damage. If a PKer appears before touching you, hopping is the better escape attempt.

preparation.title: If you die and your bones are sitting in a dangerous gravestone
preparation.text: You usually do not need to keep death-running a dangerous PvM grave. A normal gravestone lasts for 15 minutes of logged-in time, and you can ask Death to collect its contents for you. Ferox Enclave has access to Death's Office , so if retrieving the grave itself is becoming a second death trap, bank anything you kept and go there instead. The confusing “some items have been moved to Death's Office” message: if you die again while an existing grave already contains lots of normal unstackable items, the grave has a capacity rule. Excess items from the existing grave can be moved to Death's Office before the new death is added. That can make it look as though only the three items you kept on death survived, even though the rest may simply have been transferred to Death. For this route, ordinary dragon bones are individually worth less than 100,000 coins, so reclaiming those low-value items from Death is normally free . Valuable equipment can have reclamation fees, which is another reason the altar trips should contain essentially nothing except disposable bones. Important: this explanation is for an ordinary gravestone/PvM death. A death involving another player in the Wilderness can use different item-loss rules. Always check the Items Kept on Death screen before risking anything you care about.

This is not a 1,200-knife training grind; if combat consumes the first stack, return for only another 25–50. The Kourend diary already spent its separate root; count only the roots actually on hand now. If your flower harvests or seed drops ran short, take ordinary combat gear, food and a Hosidius house teleport to the level-28 hobgoblins on the peninsula north-east of the Hosidius Vinery . Kill them for their repeatable but random limpwurt-root drops, bank the missing roots, and stop exactly when you hold 20. This direct-root recovery needs no limpwurt seeds or extra Farming wait. Then complete Temple of Ikov . You do not need to grind Puro-Puro for a yew longbow. In the ice chamber, search the chests until you obtain at least 1 ice arrow . Equip the ice arrow in your ammo slot, then use darts/throwing knives on the Fire Warrior of Lesarkus; the current quest mechanics allow thrown weapons to bypass the normal yew-bow requirement. Wear Ava's attractor and retrieve recoverable knives when safe, but top up the actual shortfall rather than assuming recovery makes the starter stack infinite. Before leaving the bank: check the quest-specific quantities and sources in the preparation note.

preparation.title: Where every non-combat item comes from
preparation.text: 12 magic logs: use the protected Woodcutting/Wintertodt stock and withdraw the twelve noted for Eblis. If fewer remain, cut the missing logs at 75 Woodcutting; return to the opening Woodcutting step for that conditional gate. This quest spends twelve of the chapter's thirteen-log allocation; keep the last log banked for Mourning's End Part I. Chapter 3.1's While Guthix Sleeps supplies the later MM2 balloon logs from its storeroom loot. 6 steel bars + 1 iron bar: check the bank after clockworks, other quests and smithing. At 30 Smithing, smelt six iron ore with twelve coal into steel at an ordinary furnace; make the separate iron bar at 15 Smithing, allowing for failed iron smelts. Mine the ore or buy it from Ordan in Keldagrim. Six iron ore alone is not six steel bars. Withdraw the six steel bars noted for Eblis; keep the separate iron bar for the boots stage. 6 molten glass: withdraw the reserved glass as one noted stack of six molten glass for Eblis. It must remain molten glass. If it was blown into something else, replace it with six fresh buckets of sand and six soda ash from a charter trader, smelted at a furnace at 1 Crafting. Unpowered orbs cannot be converted back into glass. 1 silver bar: a fresh bar after Shadow of the Storm, Nature Spirit, Fenkenstrain and Animal Magnetism. Buy the shortfall from the East Ardougne Silver Merchant; do not assume one reserved bar survived all five consumers. Ashes / bones / blood rune: burn a normal log and collect its ashes; kill a chicken for ordinary bones; if already at 63 Magic, drink a Wizard's mind bomb to enter the 66-Magic Wizards' Guild in Yanille and buy a blood rune upstairs; otherwise buy it from Ali Morrisane after The Feud and Rogue Trader's rune-shop puzzle, or Lundail's shop using 1.3's bank-first Wilderness approach. A rune shop without blood-rune stock is not a supplier. Charcoal / garlic powder / spice / sweet: buy charcoal from Jiminua north-west of Tai Bwo Wannai, take garlic from the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's Draynor house and grind it, buy spice from Ardougne's spice seller, and buy a chocolate bar from the Grand Tree groceries. Keep that sweet separate from chocolate dust used in energy potions. Boots: take one spare climbing-boot pair from Death Plateau, or buy it from Tenzing for 12 coins. Bring it and the separate iron bar to Dunstan in Burthorpe for spiked boots when the ice-path stage calls for them. Keep an ordinary climbing pair available for mountain travel. Desert entry: Shantay at the pass south of Al Kharid sells passes and filled waterskins. Buy passes for the gate crossings you actually plan to make, or use an existing desert-entry bypass; carry waterskins for exposed walks. Keep carpet fares separate from the 650-coin Bandit Camp pub payment, and refill travel supplies before another desert trip. Gas mask / tinderbox / lockpicks: use Plague City's mask; reclaim it from the cupboard in Edmond's house if lost. Buy a tinderbox from a general store. At the route's 50+ Agility/Thieving, buy lockpicks from Martin Thwait in the Rogues' Den beneath Burthorpe's Toad and Chicken . Start with about 50 and replenish if unlucky; this is a buffer, not a guaranteed lock count. Bring antipoison and food for the trapped chest. The archaeologist/Rasolo and other quest NPCs supply the etchings, translation, visibility ring, keys and diamonds during their respective stages. For Dessous, first ask Malak in the Canifis pub how to kill him; Ruantun will not make the pot before that dialogue. Then take the silver bar to Ruantun in Draynor Sewers for the silver pot, bank weapons/armour for Entrana and have its High Priest bless it, return to Malak for blood, and add the garlic powder and ordinary spice. Check that the finished pot contains blood, garlic and spices before going to the graveyard. Bank completed diamonds between trips. Keep the gas mask equipped throughout the Smoke Dungeon .

preparation.title: Prayer, restore, energy and antipoison: recipes, secondaries and live quantities
preparation.text: Count doses and missing ingredients now. A normal Herblore craft makes three doses . Decant by using matching potions on one another, or ask Bob Barter at the Grand Exchange to decant to four-dose vials; decanting changes bottles, not the total doses. Water-filled vials are sold individually or in packs by Aemad in East Ardougne and Herblore shops. Prayer potion — 38 Herblore: clean ranarr + vial of water + snape grass. Twelve ranarrs with only two snape grass currently make 2 prayer(3), or 6 doses . Pick 10 more snape grass on the hobgoblin peninsula west of the Crafting Guild , outside the guild; bring food and a Falador/bank teleport. With twelve total grass and water-filled vials, twelve crafts make 36 doses = 9 prayer(4) . Farming snape grass is not required. Reserve Eadgar's separate ranarr first if that quest is unfinished. Ordinary restore — 22 Herblore: clean harralander + vial of water + red spiders' eggs . For the separate troll and Kamil trips, start by making 6 restore(3) = 18 doses , requiring 6 harralanders and 6 eggs . Reserve 12 doses = 3 restore(4) for the Kamil boss trip; the other six doses are the opening troll-trip pool. After decanting the full stock, that is four restore(4) plus one restore(2). Refill anything consumed before taking the full boss reserve. These restore drained combat stats including Magic, but not Prayer, Hitpoints or Agility . Keep the additional Heroes' Quest harralander banked. Missing eggs: enter Varrock Sewers through the manhole east of Varrock Palace , follow the sewer west to the moss-giant/deadly-red-spider end, and pick the red-spiders'-eggs ground spawns. Bring a knife or slash weapon for webs, food and a bank teleport. Pick up respawns until you have the six missing eggs; killing the spiders is unnecessary. At 51 Agility , the pipe near Vannaka connects Edgeville Dungeon to these sewers as an alternative. Stay out of Edgeville's separate Wilderness section. Energy potion — 26 Herblore: clean harralander + water-filled vial + chocolate dust. Use already-made energy potions first; otherwise buy chocolate bars from Heckel Funch in the Grand Tree and crush them with a pestle and mortar. Each new energy potion needs an additional herb after the six restore herbs and Heroes' reserve. For an opening travel/kiting buffer from zero, make three energy(3) from three additional herbs and three chocolate dust: decant eight doses into two energy(4), leaving one spare dose. Walking while run energy regenerates and banking between legs reduces demand; replace only what you use. Antipoison — 5 Herblore: buy ordinary antipoison(3) directly from Jiminua's Jungle Store , or mix clean marrentill + water-filled vial + unicorn horn dust. If making it, kill a unicorn south of Varrock and grind its horn. Start with two three-dose bottles in the bank, taking one for the trapped chest/pyramid legs and replacing it if spent. If herbs are missing: use banked clean/grimy herbs and suitable already-planted herbs first. For an immediate repeatable source, take combat gear, food and a Falador/bank teleport to Taverley Dungeon's chaos druids near the entrance, kill them for herb drops and bank until the actual named shortfall is filled. This is a random drop hunt, not a promised number of kills. Do not process every harralander into energy potions before reserving the restore ingredients. No Farming-contract reward is treated as guaranteed. Super restores are different: they need 63 Herblore, snapdragon and red spiders' eggs and restore Prayer as well as drained stats. At 41 Herblore, use ordinary restores and prayer potions as separate supplies; there is no 63-Herblore detour for this quest. How much to bring: bank the full available prayer stock, then take the per-boss amounts below. With the twelve-ranarr example, keep four prayer(4) earmarked for the ice-troll/Kamil attempt and use the other five as a starting pool for the remaining legs. Amounts depend on damage, prayer bonus, mistakes and retries; if the bank falls below the next leg's buffer, replenish it before entering. Do not try to stretch two newly-made three-dose potions over the whole quest by learning flicking under pressure. What BRUHsailer does: its Chapter 1.4 Edgeville/Varrock-sewers stop collects about seven eggs , shared between diary uses, DT restores and Guthix balance. It later explicitly spends prayer potions and death runes on DT, alongside high-attention boss methods. Seven earlier eggs are not a guaranteed six-egg balance after those other consumers; this local pickup remains available if that route stop was skipped. BRUHsailer source .

preparation.title: Runes, food and a bankable starting kit
preparation.text: Use the standard spellbook for the four bosses. Buy only missing air/water/fire/mind/chaos/death runes from Aubury in Varrock or Betty in Port Sarim; refill coins with the established Thieving method if needed. Buy elemental staffs from Zaff in Varrock. The MTA rune purchases are already partly spent, and the 100-chaos-rune Chapter 2 reserve must remain after DT. Opening spell stock, not a fixed kill guarantee: prepare roughly 200 casts per boss , then replace any real shortfall before a retry. Fire Bolt needs 1 chaos + 3 air + 4 fire per cast (35 Magic); a fire staff covers fire runes. Water Bolt needs 1 chaos + 2 air + 2 water (23 Magic). For the no-gloves Fareed method, carry all three rune types even if you start with a staff. Higher water spells are an option if you have the level/runes, but do not make the plan depend on a staff staying equipped. Fire Bolt is deliberately low enough to survive some Kamil stat drain. Wear ordinary Magic gear already obtained: elemental staff, wizard hat/robes and an amulet of magic, with available defensive pieces that do not ruin spell accuracy. Chaos gauntlets from the completed Family Crest improve bolt spells if you select that enchantment; normal family/goldsmith/cooking gauntlets do not give the bolt bonus. Existing gear is sufficient preparation; there is no required Mystic, Barrows, Graceful or stamina grind. For boss trips, use cooked swordfish or better banked food . If the food bank is empty, harpoon swordfish/tuna at Catherby at 50 Fishing, cook them at your 60 Cooking and keep going until the next inventory is filled; buy the harpoon from Harry. Take roughly 12–16 food after the current leg's potions/runes/quest items, plus a charged bank teleport. Kamil needs an item teleport such as a ring of dueling in the inventory, since drained Magic can disable teleport spells. Bank between bosses and refill Prayer at an altar before each trip.

preparation.title: Fareed: water spells, the glove tooltip and optional kiting
preparation.text: Quest Helper's wording is about your weapon hand. Without ice gloves, Fareed can unequip your weapon when he reaches you. That includes a water staff: having water runes supplied by the staff does not protect the staff. The direct no-gloves plan is to enter with the weapon slot empty and manually cast water spells with all their air, water and catalytic runes in inventory . Bank the staff for this method; if you choose to wield one initially, leave a free inventory slot for it when disarmed. Water spells are the damaging Magic option here; gloves do not make Iban Blast or a fire spell work. Keep the gas mask on. Take 1–2 prayer(4) , food and water-spell runes; leave Protect from Melee on when he can reach you and eat through occasional other damage. For the lower-damage alternative, bring energy potions, cast once and run around the room to keep distance. If he catches you, the three inventory rune stacks still let you keep manual casting. Banking/retrying is preferable to running out of water runes mid-fight. Optional glove route: at 50 Mining, take a pickaxe, food, combat supplies and a teleport through White Wolf Mountain to the Ice Queen's lair, defeat her and collect ice gloves . Starting Heroes' Quest is not required. They let you keep a staff equipped for water-spell autocast. Smiths gloves (i) are the Giants' Foundry gloves combined with ice gloves; plain smiths gloves and goldsmith gauntlets do not substitute. There is no reason to grind the Foundry outfit just for Fareed. Ice Queen route .

preparation.title: Damis: establish the rat or bat block, then cast
preparation.text: Take the ring of visibility, runes, food, a bank teleport and 2 prayer(4) as a setup/recovery buffer. Damis's second form drains Prayer rapidly when it reaches you; a larger potion stack alone is an awkward answer to that mechanic. Use the rat/bat block: keep a rat or giant bat alive in the arena, turn auto-retaliate off, and lure it between you and Damis so he cannot reach melee range. Set up while the first form is alive; use a weak hit only if needed to get the blocker following you. Leave Protect from Melee on during the lure. Once the blocker is actually holding Damis and you are taking no attacks, cast from that position and turn prayer off. Keep the block for the second form; do not run so far away that the encounter resets. If the blocker moves or dies, put Protect from Melee back on and re-establish it or teleport. The technique saves supplies through positioning; it does not require flicking. Use the current Damis positioning illustration for the exact layout instead of guessing a tile from a textual direction.

preparation.title: Dessous: keep one overhead on and budget food
preparation.text: Bring the completed blessed blood mixture, combat runes, 2 prayer(4) , plenty of food and a teleport. The relaxed default is to stand in melee range and leave Protect from Melee on while using Magic and eating through the other attack. Do not kite around the graveyard fence as though it were a permanent safespot: repeated Dessous teleports can end the encounter and cost another blood mixture. BRUHsailer's alternating Melee/Missiles prayer trick is an optional high-attention method, separate from basic lazy flicking. It is not a requirement for this route. If you leave or fail the fight, keep the blessed pot, return to Malak for fresh blood and rebuild the garlic/spice mixture before another attempt; having the old empty pot is not the same as having a usable summon mixture.

preparation.title: Kamil: separate troll trip, Fire Bolt and ordinary restores
preparation.text: Clear the five ice trolls first. Bring the child's sweet, climbing boots, food, prayer potions, Fire Bolt runes and the six-dose ordinary-restore pool . The cold drains stats on this trip too; use restores to keep Fire Bolt available. The five kills persist, so leave and bank after opening the way. Refill anything used until you again have the full 4 prayer(4) + 3 restore(4) boss inventory below, fresh food, full Prayer and restored stats. If more than the opening restore pool was needed for trolls, make the additional potions before returning. For the boss trip: take about 4 prayer(4), 3 ordinary restore(4) , Fire Bolt runes, a fire staff, food, spiked boots for the path afterwards and an item-based emergency teleport. Two rings of recoil are useful extra damage: make two sapphire rings from two additional gold bars/sapphires and enchant each with 1 cosmic + 1 water rune at 7 Magic; equip one and carry the spare. They are separate from teleport-jewellery reserves, and the fight does not depend on owning them. Get him into melee range and leave Protect from Melee on. On the approach, Protect from Magic can cover the initial magic hits; once close, switch to Melee. That is one situational switch, not continuous flicking. Keep casting Fire Bolt . His freezes can interrupt attacking, so re-click the spell/boss or resume autocast when control returns. Watch current Magic and Prayer separately. Drink an ordinary restore before Magic falls below Fire Bolt's 35 requirement; drink a prayer dose to maintain the overhead. At 63 Magic there is useful headroom, but cold keeps draining stats. Eat early enough to survive the next hit. If the first attempt is consuming the supplies faster than expected, teleport while you still can, replenish and retry. After the kill: collect the dropped food and super restore , then continue the ice path wearing spiked boots. The dropped super restore can restore the Agility that ordinary restores could not; it is a post-kill aid and cannot fund the fight that earns it. Keep food for falls and the remaining cold damage, and retain fire-spell runes to break the ice around both parents at the end. The old rock/player-block Kamil methods are not the default because their reliability depends on positioning and changed encounter behaviour. Use the direct fire-spell plan and leave any flick practice for an easier enemy.

preparation.title: Learn lazy flicking separately with RuneLite timing aids
preparation.text: RuneLite's built-in Prayer plugin can show the prayer-flick indicator on the prayer orb and the prayer-dose indicator. Its built-in Metronome gives an audible game-tick beat; start with one tick per beat at a comfortable volume. These are timing aids, not automatic prayer toggles, and the beat alone does not identify an enemy's attack phase. Practise on one weak melee enemy near an altar with auto-retaliate off: watch several attacks, turn Protect from Melee on before the next attack begins , leave it through that attack, then switch off during the gap. Do not wait for the damage number. If you lose the rhythm, leave prayer on. This lazy-flick practice is much easier to learn than rapid off/on clicks every 0.6-second tick, and you can finish DT before mastering either. Prayer plugin · Metronome .

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: With The Dig Site, The Tourist Trap, Troll Stronghold, Priest in Peril, Waterfall Quest and Temple of Ikov completed, the quest prerequisites are done. Check actual 53 Thieving : 1.2 guarantees only 50. If still short after the intervening quests, use Wealthy Citizens/house valuables or Ardougne Knights for the live remainder. Also confirm 50 Magic, 50 Firemaking, 10 Slayer and 43 Prayer ; 43 Prayer is this guide's combat preparation, not a quest-start requirement. The default is to leave the appropriate protection prayer on, bank between diamonds and use the boss-specific positioning below. One-tick flicking, alternating overheads every tick, ice gloves and super restores are not assumed. Ordinary restores solve Kamil's drained Magic; they do not restore Prayer. Prepare the two potion types separately before going to the ice area. Opening bank check: 12 magic logs, 6 steel bars, 6 molten glass, 1 ashes, 1 charcoal, 1 blood rune, 1 ordinary bones, 1 silver bar, garlic, pestle and mortar, spice, one chocolate bar/cake, climbing boots, 1 iron bar, gas mask, tinderbox, about 50 lockpicks, Shantay passes for any desert gate crossings, waterskins for desert walks, and at least 650 coins plus travel money. These are quest-wide supplies; withdraw only the current leg's items. Open the preparation notes before the first trip. Eblis departure: withdraw 12 magic logs, 6 steel bars and 6 molten glass as three noted stacks. Bring ashes, charcoal, one blood rune and ordinary bones alongside them. These materials use seven inventory slots, leaving room for coins, desert travel supplies, food and a teleport. Keep the thirteenth magic log banked for Mourning's End Part I. The glass must still be molten glass; noting it does not mean crafting it into another item. Final pyramid: rebank the combat kit, bring all four diamonds, food, antipoison, some energy potions and a teleport, then place the diamonds and finish the pyramid. Traps can throw you back out; replenish used supplies before another run. Speak to Azzanadra for completion, then follow the Paddewwa step. Optional future pickup: bank one Trollweiss for Troll Romance if your ice-area route makes it convenient. Otherwise collect it with that quest's own setup later.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: After Desert Treasure, switch to Ancient Magicks and prepare: 108 soft clay 108 air runes 216 law runes Fire staff Check existing soft clay first. The eight bracelets of clay banked earlier each convert 28 ordinary clay to soft clay while mining; from zero, four fresh bracelets cover 112 clay. Mine only the shortfall at an ordinary clay mine such as south-west Varrock, and stop when you have 108 soft clay. Check the law-rune balance after Mage Training Arena and earlier teleports; buy only the shortfall at a stocked rune shop, using the repeatable Thieving cash method if necessary. Travel back to the Ancient Pyramid : its ancient lectern beside the altar on the fourth level makes the tablets while Ancient Magicks is active. This is not a POH furniture requirement. At 54+ Magic, make 108 Paddewwa teleport tablets . The Earth-orb grind itself uses only part of this stack, but making the full batch now avoids repeating the spellbook/lectern setup later.

preparation.title: Twilight's two combat styles and Scrambled's local materials
preparation.text: Twilight's Promise: take weapons/ammunition for two different combat styles , such as the rune sword and Magic staff/runes, plus food and a teleport. One melee weapon with different attack settings is not two styles. The quest's insignia and related objects are supplied during the quest. Scrambled!: its bowl of water, 2 normal planks, 6 nails, saw and hammer can all be collected during the quest's local tasks; check the nearby marked containers before shopping. Bring combat gear/food and actual 38 Construction (the preceding live check targets 39). Keep spare nails if collected because bent nails do not count as completed repairs. These are ordinary planks, not oak planks.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Children of the Sun was completed in 1.2 , so the Varlamore chain is ready. Complete Twilight’s Promise , then—with 39 Construction now guaranteed—complete Scrambled! . Then use the Tal Teklan rune shop and other existing stock to bring your bank to 4,900 cosmic runes total . The orb batch consumes 4,770 cosmic runes —three per orb—so 4,900 leaves a small buffer for enchanting and mistakes. The 1.2 coin target is an opening reserve, not a guaranteed balance after MTA, sand, Magic training and quest purchases. Check liquid coins before buying: if short, do a bounded Wealthy Citizen/house-valuables refill in Civitas illa Fortis and return for the remaining runes; do not count banked alchables as spendable coins. Before leaving the bank: check the quest-specific quantities and sources in the preparation note.

route_steps.visible_checkpoint: Magic and spellbook checkpoint: read your actual Magic XP after MTA, quests and jewellery. Charge Earth Orb needs 60 Magic on the standard spellbook , and early 2.1 needs actual 63 Magic to boost into the Wizards' Guild. If below 63, train only the live remainder with ordinary elemental combat on safe, low-defence targets or sensible banked High Alchemy, buying runes in small batches; do not spend the nature runes intended for the 2.1 battlestaves without budgeting replacements. Switch back from Ancient Magicks to the standard spellbook at the Desert Pyramid before the first orb trip. Paddewwa tablets remain usable as teleports after switching. Use the low-complexity version rather than the gravestone/corpse method: Equip an earth staff and a bank teleport such as a ring of dueling. Withdraw 25 unpowered orbs , 75 cosmic runes and 1 Paddewwa tablet . Break the Paddewwa tablet and run through Edgeville Dungeon to the Earth Obelisk . Cast Charge Earth Orb until all 25 are charged. Teleport to a bank, deposit the Earth orbs, restock, repeat. Continue until all 1,590 are charged. This is slower than an optimized death/gravestone storage route, but it is much easier to follow and produces the same Chapter 2 resource.

Animal Magnetism (+1,000 Crafting), Enlightened Journey (+2,000), and The Hand in the Sand (+9,000) are now complete; finish/check the 1,590 unpowered orbs and the full jewellery stock before deciding. Read actual Crafting XP, not an old projected level. Preserve the 1,590 charged Earth orbs and every named quest resource. Already actual 58+: you can attach Earth orbs to battlestaves in 2.1 without any pie. Do not hunt Sulliuscep caps. Below 58, with caps/pies: mushroom pie gives +4 Crafting per bite. If five caps arrived during Woodcutting, make four pies (and keep one cap spare): mix four flour with water, put four pastry dough in four pie dishes, add one cap to each and bake at a range with your 60 Cooking. Bank the pies for 2.1. If you have fewer, use only a stock you judge sufficient to bridge the live XP gap; otherwise use the permanent-level option. Below 58, without enough pies: train only the live XP remainder to actual 58 with banked gems or separately gathered sand/soda ash/glass. Do not take from the protected orb or quest supplies. Once the skill tab reads 58, stop. This checkbox is only the Crafting-readiness outcome: actual 58 Crafting or sufficient mushroom-pie boosts to begin Earth battlestaves. Earlier steps already track actual 70 Woodcutting and 1,590 charged Earth orbs; do not count either again here. Caps and extra-glass training are methods, not separate required progress.
